reviews.title: A good flight with some challenging passenger behaviour
reviews.text: Providing information to Indian passengers in a language they could understand may help to facilitate the boarding process which was horrible due to ignoring instructions, line jumping, etc. The staff was extremely patient (and they needed to be). The food was delicious for an airline. I wish they would caption the movies shown on the in flight entertainment movies.
reviews.author: Tom F

reviews.title: What a nice surprise this airline was!
reviews.text: What a pleasant surprise! We selected upgraded economy seats which were still cheaper than other carriers. Checked bags included. These seats were in a part of the cabin with only six rows. I was greeted by a smiling staff, and a pillow and headphones waiting on my seat. I was offered a choice of juice or sparking wine as I sat down. The plane was a Boeing 787 which departed on time. Hot meals with wine offered both ways with a snack before landing. Meal out of Italy of course was better than the one from New York. Movies, television, and music were offered. Service was always pleasant. Debarking at Malpensa was a breeze. Passport readers were electronic and quick. Trains to Milan were easy. There are a number of carriers that fly this route. This was the best value with a nearly new airplane. The airline is not as well known but is the second largest Italian carrier. I would not hesitate to use them on any of their routes throughout europe.
reviews.author: Neil K

reviews.title: All around excellent to and from NYC
reviews.text: i can't recall how I found NEOS online, but when i saw their variation of prices for different fares and what was included, i pulled the trigger and got 4 seats. I upgraded to the economy plus (row 5 through 10) just for a little more room, as it was only 80ish more per seat. i do not recommend row 5 if your tall or with a waistline greater than a 40US waist. , the seats are behind a bullhead and have the video screens embedded in the seats. so they get a big rigid. The staff was efficient for all of "economy" and they are all italian, so if you're english speaking only, you're going to be reduced to types of drinks and yes please and no thank you. plane was quiet, smooth and i will use them again!
reviews.author: Al H

reviews.title: Premiere Seats on Neos.. NOT ECONOMY
reviews.text: We were apprehensive to take this airline since we knew nothing about them. It was hard to find really good info on what exactly to expect. We flew their premier seats. You are allowed 2 checked bags approx. 60 lbs each. We checked in on the Web Check In 24 hours prior with no problem. When we got to Term 1 JFK the bag drop/check in is located at area C. We easily dropped our bags and they gave us another boarding pass. We quickly made our way through premier/1st class security line. Boarding starts 1 hour prior to departure. We easily walked right through the crowd to pre board with our premier seats. The airplane was clean, new and welcoming. The premier seats had a refreshing bag, pillow and blanket. USB, large TV screen and comfortable wide seat. Your footrest comes out and you recline to a very comfortable position. It is comparable to regular 1st class not Polaris. A drink was offered while boarding. Hot towels then Dinner was served and was surprisingly fairly good. Served on plates as a first class meal would be. They serve you in 3 courses.. your salad, entree then dessert. With more beverages served. Alcohol was all inclusive.. wine and beer is what we had. The staff was very accommodating from beginning to end. But we are generally very pleased and happy people.. maybe that helps. When you arrive in MXP, expect to walk down the portable stairs and take a shuttle bus. Our luggage came out in a timely manner and we rented a car that was easily done as well. I got a t
reviews.author: JoyB

reviews.title: Bad customer service
reviews.text: The flight was fine – the only flight I've taken that serves wine with the meal, which was a plus, and it's the first flight in a long time that took off on time and had enough overhead space for carry on bags. However, on our flight back from Milan to New York, they didn't have a record of us pre requesting 2 vegetarian meals, and the one "vegetarian" meal they gave us was actually vegan (I love cheese!) and when we asked them to clarify what was in the other meal they gave us instead, they kept insisting the cheese and spinach ravioli was not vegetarian but that they didn't have any "vegetarian" meals for us. For the rest of the flight, when drink and snack service was offered, they passed by us without asking what we wanted, and we didn't get that meal. Flight crew needs better training on different dietary restrictions and could have offered better service for the rest of the flight.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Suprised
reviews.text: We saw a great fare on Neos over Easter and decided to risk a nightmare flight it was so inexpensive. The booking was a little tricky as it’s obviously an Italian carrier and all administrative processes take place over there. Our ticketing, luggage and boarding were seemless upon arrival at JFK and the airplane and flight crew a joy. The flight had a 1970s feel to it with flight attendants in high heels and hats pouring free wine and alcohol beverages. A meal and breakfast were served while onboard and even included real metal silverware. We all agreed it was the best flight we had taken in decades!

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service- Refund for My Father's Passing
reviews.text: I have never had such a terrible experience as I contacted the airline for a flight refund since my Father passed away and I needed to bury him hence why I could not fly. They told me to submit a ticket online to have corporate review the request. The website timed me out every time I attempted to do such. I called and emailed the NYC office and they did not assist by opening a ticket for me. At this point, I had to buy another airline ticket to return to Italy and still have no response. When burying your Father, this is not proper to put someone through. It is frankly DISGRACEFUL. I will never fly them again. I now will get an attorney in my family to send this to small claims.

reviews.text: I had a flight with Neos Air in August this year with my 8 year old daughter and my brother to Milan where we were connecting to Portugal. The. Service assistants for Neos Air looked at our passports and told us that the visas issued by the embassy had been used!! What????!! Does that even make any sense?? We called the embassy and they denied and disagreed with the nonsense the Neos Air staff were talking about. We noticed that we were not the only passengers they were denying boarding, it was only Kenyans that were not allowed to board the airline with baseless reasons. The staff were rude when we complained and felt nothing talking back to us. The minute the boarding time reached they left without a care and left us all there stranded. I was shocked that a foreign airline can be allowed to be racist to Kenyan citizens in their own country! Not only this but they have refused to refund us for all the expenses incurred after sending several messages. I'm disgusted by the airline and it's arrogant staff. Emirates saved the day and got us to our destination on the same day without a hitch. I recommend EMIRATES to anyone wanting to fly. The staff were all amazing and helped us forget about the nasty experience we went through! I have attached a picture of the terrible staff that were on duty that day and I have a recording of them denying my sister booking the next week until she mentioned she worked in media. reviews.title: Arrogant staff and no perfect service !!!
reviews.text: Our flight wasn´t as we hoped to. The staff was arrogant and absolutely unhelpful. We sat next to the "kitchen" and when the staff came to us with food and drink, there is almost nothing to drink (only tomato juice and water). When we wanted a white wine (after the take off) the staff told us we have to wait. After an hour we asked again and the answer was the same. As I wrote when the staff came to us with drinks there was no wine any more. There was only chance to buy it but only red wine. All of it lasts for about 4 hours! Also when we wanted something from the menu on board there was just a few drinks like Coca Cola, 7 Up but 85 % of the menu wasn´t available. It´s horrible and we would never ever fly with Neos Air again! Really not to recommend!
reviews.author: Anna M

reviews.title: Great flight for a great price
reviews.text: The flight was fine. Nothing luxurious but I fly economy - but at this price, I could afford to fly economy plus and we had lots of space. The food was ok - nothing to rave and/or complain about. Cabin crew was professional and available for aid. The flight was uneventful - which is EXACTLY what I want a flight to be. We took off late but that was traffic at the airport not a Neos problem. Before takeoff, the gate was moved at JFK and the gate agent made sure that anyone in the area knew about it (I had a gate be changed on TAP and barely made it to the correct gate because it was not well announced Customer service - well, I wish that there was an app for Neos. Also, trying to get in touch with customer service is amazingly difficult. I would 100% fly again.
reviews.author: RMF333

reviews.title: Very pleasantly surprised!
reviews.text: Prior to flying this trip, we had not heard of NEOS before, so we were a bit hesitant to make a reservation. The prices were so inexpensive for this trip, we felt it might be one of those "too good to be true" situations. You know the type - you're promised the world and end up with a shocking disappointment... Well, it wasn't that way at all. From the very first person we saw (while checking in), every employee was considerate, friendly, and very professional. The airliner itself looked new, and everything was clean. I mean, really clean. We didn't feel like we had to "Chlorox Wipe" everything, even in the bathrooms - a welcome change from some airlines we have flown. We were also served a DELICIOUS MEAL. Those words don't usually go together when discussing airline food! But this was really tasty and the servings were plentiful. We've flown on one of the top rated (for food) airlines, and this meal was superior to the meals we've had on the top rated airline. We paid a whopping $22 for extra legroom, and we were quite comfortable on our trans-Atlantic flight. They provide (paid) wifi, but if you don't need to use the computer, the entertainment is comparable to most airlines. All in all, NEOS made the grade and then some. We've found our new favorite airline!

reviews.title: Everything leading up was not great but the flight itself was good.
reviews.text: So, at the end of the day, for the price, I can recommend this flight from Milan to NYC. I booked well in advance and was able to secure their most premium offering for $600. Flying abroad at that price in a premium cabin is not normal so I was both excited and skeptical. At first things were ok, I booked it online, printed my confirmation and created an account. Then the website glitched and I was never able to complete getting an email confirmation for my flight. My anxiety didn’t like that because I’m used to being able to check on my status with my flight as often as I’d like, But the day I purchased was the only day I could see that I actually had a spot on the plane. I tried to release that and just hoped that everything was still smooth and on time, but in the days leading up to me leaving Italy I tried to reach out to the airline to see if they could locate my res. Over about 2 days of verrrrry slow communication, they ultimately “did not see my reservation sorry” …….. what?! So then I spent the rest of my trip freaking out, and praying that I would walk up to check in and they would have record of me. That pre flight customer service almost makes this a 3 out of 5, I would hate to know what it would be like to cancel or reschedule etc. The best part about the flight itself was the food and the service.
